properties.name: gear
properties.description: Per-slot gear controller: what the player wears on each body slot and what they can wear there. Reads come from the client's last report and are synchronous; equip, unequip and apply are client round trips whose callback fires once the worn set agrees, carrying the appliedRevision it settled at. Prefer apply for a multi-slot change: it costs one round trip and one client tick instead of one per slot. Slots and item-to-slot mapping come from the game's own tables, so gear added by a UGC mod behaves like shipped gear.

properties.name: wand
properties.description: The player's wand: whether it is drawn, which wand it is, and the styles the game offers. Reads come from the client's last report and are synchronous; equip, unequip and setStyle are client round trips with a callback. The game's own behaviour tree also draws and stows the wand, so equip/unequip are requests, not latches - a callback can come back WAND_REVERTED.

properties.name: effects
properties.description: Timed potion effects. apply/clear command the owning client (the ability lives there); has/list read the server-owned mask.
